raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE: 3.5+ YEARS KogniVera | Feb 2025 -JAN 2026 Project: Hotel Booking Service
Developed a Full-Stack Hotel Booking and Property Management Platform with a responsive Angular frontend and a scalable Spring Boot microservices backend. Built Angular standalone components for hotel search, filters, room availability, and booking flow, integrating backend services using REST APIs, RxJS, and HTTPClient. Implemented JWT-based authentication, secure payment gateway integration, notifications, PDF invoice generation. Used Hibernate/JPA for ORM, MySQL for database design, AWS S3 for image and document storage. Followed Agile methodology, used Git for version control and Postman for API testing.
BPO Convergence Pvt Ltd. | June 2024 -Jan2025 Project: Payroll Management System
Developed a Spring Boot—based Payroll Management System to automate salary Processing, employee compensation, and payroll reporting for an IT organization. The system features JWT, role-based access control and secure data handling for HR, Admin, and Employee users. Focused on improving efficiency, transparency and data integrity through modular architecture and optimized backend design.
Silverlink Technologies I July 2022 - June 2024
Project: Online Travel Agency
Developed an Online Travel Agency System, a Spring Boot—based web application that enables users to search, book and manage bus travel services with secure authentication and real-time booking updates. Integrated OTP and JWT-based authentication, payment gateway processing for seamless and secure user experience. Built a robust backend using Java 8, Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA, and MySQL, ensuring optimized performance and reliable data management through well-structured entity relationships and efficient queries.
raw_sections.projects:
Key Projects: Roles and Responsibilities: ● Developed RESTful services using Spring Boot, entity creation, service layers and controllers. ● Managed MySQL database interactions using Hibernate and JPA, ensuring optimized Queries and Performance. ● Implemented Spring Security, JWT for secure user authentication and RBAC. ● Designed Queue-based async processing for booking confirmation emails and notifications. ● Configured and registered Microservices with Eureka Server for service discovery and used Feign Clients for interservice communication. ● Developed API Gateway for centralized routing and request management across services. ● Implemented real-time notification services, including SMS, email, and push notifications, to keep users updated on order statuses and delivery timelines. ● Optimized database design and queries with ER diagrams and NoSQL. ● Integrated Git with CI/CD tools like Jenkins/GitHub Actions for automated pipeline triggers. ● Implemented unit testing using JUnit and Mockito to verify service reliability and reduce Regression issues. ● Designed and optimized payload classes and applied database normalization techniques to enhance performance, scalability, and data integrity. ● Production issues, analyzing logs, and identifying root causes. Known for delivering clean, modular, and reusable code, adhering to SOLID principles, design patterns, and best
practices in software engineering.
